from z3 import *

# Define variables
n_dice = 5
n_faces = 6
max_val = 11

x = [[Int(f'x_{i}_{j}') for j in range(n_faces)] for i in range(n_dice)]

s = Solver()

# Domain and sorted constraints
for i in range(n_dice):
    for j in range(n_faces):
        s.add(x[i][j] >= 0, x[i][j] <= max_val)
    for j in range(n_faces - 1):
        s.add(x[i][j] <= x[i][j+1])

# Beat constraints: for each i, count of pairs where die i > die (i+1)%5 >= 19
for i in range(n_dice):
    next_i = (i + 1) % n_dice
    count = []
    for a in range(n_faces):
        for b in range(n_faces):
            count.append(If(x[i][a] > x[next_i][b], 1, 0))
    s.add(Sum(count) >= 19)

print("Solving...")
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    sol = []
    for i in range(n_dice):
        die = [m.evaluate(x[i][j]).as_long() for j in range(n_faces)]
        sol.extend(die)
        print(f"Die {i}: {die}")
    print("Solution:", sol)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
